Description.Name: Jenny Ospring
Description.Details: Jenny Ospring, callsign "Lighter", was named for her peculiarly grim-toned catchphrase on her Leopard rides home "...Anyone got a light?". She is known throughout the Periphery as a calculating contract killer, who never leaves a mark breathing past her employer's initial deposit for work. She is often under the employ of both local governments and savvy commanders, as no one can argue with the results - especially those who can afford her services.
